title: Stabilize prefetch shaping; implement lock-free KV compaction pipeline
creator: Ava Chen
description: Background: Over the last year we accumulated several ad-hoc fixes around the continuous batch admission path and the KV cache compaction flow. Symptoms include sporadic latency spikes under short-tailed burst workloads, noisy prefetch traffic causing hot-shard contention, and long tail pauses during compaction cycles when global locks are taken. This ticket aims to replace the coarse-grained compaction lock and brittle prefetch heuristics with a lock-free per-shard compaction pipeline and a workload-aware prefetch shaper. The goal is to reduce p99 latency by ~30% for bursty traffic and remove multi-second compaction pauses observed in internal load tests.
acceptance_criteria: Continuous batching admission no longer experiences >3x request latency variance under 1s bursts in our smoke harness
KV compaction no longer stalls serving threads for more than 200ms during steady-state compaction in the BE benchmark
New prefetch shaper limits aggregate prefetch IOPS to configured budget with <5% overshoot across 100 runs
End-to-end e2e job adding the new pipeline is covered by unit tests and an integration test that simulates shard skew
Performance dashboards updated: new metrics surfaced and alert thresholds documented
tasks: Design lock-free compaction state machine and sequence counters (design doc)
Implement per-shard compaction worker with atomic sequence handoff
Replace global compaction mutex with cooperative compaction protocol
Implement prefetch shaper: token-bucket per host + backlog-aware scaling
Add metrics: compaction_inflight_ms, compaction_pause_count, prefetch_tokens_used, prefetch_budget_overshoot
Benchmark: run microbench for KV compaction and continuous batch harness before/after
Rollout plan: feature-flag behind runtime.kv_compaction_v2 + canary on 5% traffic
Documentation: update runtime-ops playbook and console dashboard tiles
